name: analyze-system-dynamics
job: Explain behavior over time with stocks, flows, feedback loops, and intervention analysis.

inScope: Framing focal behavior, decisions, boundary, and time horizon
Drawing behavior-over-time patterns and stock-flow structure
Connecting feedback loops with delays, thresholds, and adaptive actors
Simulating scenarios and testing interventions across horizons
outOfScope: Static dependency, module, or deployment graphs (architecture methods)
Bounded defect analysis without feedback dynamics (analyze-critically)

inputs: The behavior or decision to explain and its time horizon
Observations of how the behavior changes over time
System boundary and candidate structure evidence
outputs: Dynamic System Model: question, structure, and model status
Intervention analysis with leverage points and failure modes
Validation plan with discriminating measures and revision triggers
failureSemantics: A causal-loop diagram is a hypothesis, not evidence; qualitative models are labeled qualitative without invented parameter precision, and conditions requiring model revision are explicit.

outcome.observable: A Dynamic System Model with explicit model status (observed facts versus hypotheses), intervention analysis, and a validation plan an independent analyst can replay.
